title: To Acquire Wisdom: The Way of Wang Yang-ming
author: Julia Ching
citation_detail: New York: Columbia University Press, 1976. ISBN 0-231-03968-7. xxvi + 373 pp. Revised and expanded from Ching's 1971 ANU doctoral dissertation. Standard English-language monograph on Wang Yangming's life and philosophy. For Japanese Yangmingism reception (C025, C026): see Part Three, chapters on Wang Yangming's legacy and influence beyond China; also Ching's discussion of the transmission to Japan in the concluding chapter. Specific page references for Nakae Tōju, Japanese Yangmingism, and late Tokugawa figures need verification against the published text.
note: Standard English-language monograph on Wang Yangming. Replaced placeholder entry (v2 hardening sprint, 2026-05-12). Covers Wang Yangming's life, philosophical development, core doctrines (liang-chih, unity of knowledge and action), and legacy. Japanese Yangmingism coverage: discussed in concluding sections; claims C025 and C026 cite this as primary source for the broader context of Wang Yangming's influence on Japanese thought. For more focused coverage of Japanese Yangmingism, see also: Barry Steben, various articles on Ōyōmei-gaku; Tetsuo Najita, Japan: The Intellectual Foundations of Modern Japanese Politics.
